L1·N9427unmasked layer
Fires on the second/completing token of a multiword proper name or brand-like compound (Payne **Smith**, Pottery **Barn**, Kingdom Hearts **HD**, her+**ongyang**), and on the head noun ending a fixed phrase ("placeholder **page**", "KEY FEATURES **INCLUDE**"); it is strongly suppressed when that completing token is a place/venue name element (Hall, Cottage, Mills).
